root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: on the `parser->time_with_year` else-path, `time_ptr == tmp` before `flb_strptime(time_ptr, parser->time_fmt, tm)`
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `flb_parser_time_lookup()` calls `flb_strptime()` on the `parser->time_with_year` else-path, the bounded slice must first be copied into the local `tmp` buffer and `time_ptr` rebound to that NUL-terminated copy.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original records `strptime_arg_ptr != safe_tmp_ptr` at the root call while the same `_conv_num` event still executes, proving the raw logfmt slice is passed directly into `flb_strptime()`. The fixed original records `strptime_arg_ptr == safe_tmp_ptr` while `_conv_num` still executes, showing the call now uses the local terminated copy instead.

nodes.state: At the `%d` branch, `_flb_strptime()` calls `_conv_num(&bp, ...)` with `bp` already equal to the end pointer of the string previously handed to `flb_strptime()`, i.e. the parser has consumed `%s.` and is now positioned exactly at the slice boundary.
`_conv_num()` immediately dereferences the same cursor via `**buf` in its first digit test, which is the AddressSanitizer-reported read.

edges.relation: The end pointer of the argument handed to `flb_strptime()` becomes the `bp` cursor that `_flb_strptime()` passes into the `%d` parser after `%s.` consumes the in-bounds bytes.
The same cursor passed by `_flb_strptime()` as `&bp` arrives in `_conv_num()` as `*buf`, and `_conv_num()` dereferences it in the crashing digit test.
